member.name: T:Archivory.IBinarySerializer`1
member.summary: Generic stream-based binary serializer contract. Implementations own a self-describing on-disk format (typically a magic + version header) and define how a value of is written to / read from a stream.

remarks.para: The first primitive in the Archivory project — the long-term home for the repository's persistence layer. The current shape is intentionally minimal (stream-write + stream-read + canonical file extension); a fuller blittable-archive primitive (manifest + compression + seek-able partial reads) is planned to land here alongside this interface, with concrete consumers migrating onto it as it matures.

The Tabular project is conceptually a specialization within Archivory's broader mission — CSV is a lossy, human-readable projection — and is expected to fold in here over time. For now the two coexist as siblings while Archivory's surface stabilizes.

member.name: M:Archivory.BinarySerializerBase`1.WriteToFile(`0,System.String)
member.summary: Atomically write to . Writes to {path}.tmp first, then renames; a partial write never leaves a half-written file at the canonical path. The rename fails (throws) if the destination already exists — checkpoint files are treated as write-once.
